boundary.rule: w=0.1+0.9*(1-exp(-(d/8)^2)); d=min(distance to Background,distance to Ring) on original RGB label lattice; pixel-center EDT; no resized-mask distances

stop.scope: numerical/hardware emergency only; CAD contact and poor loss not an early stop

multiview_HERO: diagnostics after prediction freeze only; never optimization, weighting, selection or ranking
model_selection: fixed final300 only; report stopped runs as failures, never best-checkpoint selection

base_strategy.plane_sign: normalized and acute aligned, d flips synchronously; common original internal anchor
base_strategy.contact: frozen data-only original 009 contact; BROAD => clip regardless old base quality
base_strategy.weak_plane: smallest ROI upper30/45/60 with N>=100 and inlier>=0.5; otherwise nearest available plane, uncertainty preserved
base_strategy.clip: exact original B triangle halfspace intersection; no re-fit or smoothing
base_strategy.cap: ear-clipped inferred planar closure, excluded from all observation losses; boundary vertices normal motion projected away in global/local stages

sphere.source: primary FIT real Mask bounding box + median reliable original axial HERO; center ray through bbox center, depth zmedian+0.5r; r=max(metric half-width,metric half-height),minimum0.25mm
sphere.normalization: same sphere-derived center and radius for both routes per case
